text:
kevin: Heads-up — Zenith Payments just signed an NDA and wants a 6-week pilot. Scope: embeddings + rerank for support search, plus a single toolcall to fetch transaction metadata. Need scope + success criteria + rough pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated. Who can own technical scoping?
julia: I can take it. Quick Q: do they actually need 32k context or was that high-level?
kevin: Sales said 'long docs' but not specific. I'll confirm details. Also they flagged PCI and will want security questionnaire answered before infra talk.
sarah: Re: ownership — I can help define acceptance metrics and eval prompts. We should lock success criteria before infra estimates.
omar: For model fit: embeddings + retriever->rerank is standard. Embeddings size depends on recall targets; we usually prototype with our 1536-d embedding open model. For rerank a small cross-encoder (or a bi-encoder + lightweight cross-check) works. If they insist on toolcalling, make sure the tool is idempotent & audited.
julia: Sounds good. Proposed acceptance metrics (draft):
1) P@5 >= 0.75 on curated support queries (50 queries)
2) Mean reciprocal rank (MRR) improvement >= 20% vs baseline
3) 95th perc. latency for search+rerank <= 350ms (hosted) or <= 200ms (dedicated)
4) No PII leakage in 0/100 sampled outputs during eval runs

sarah: + add uptime during pilot >= 99.5% and error rate < 1% for toolcall.
kevin: Good. Sales will need a one-pager with timelines and cost bands. Can someone sketch Hosted vs Dedicated pricing/ops tradeoffs?
omar: Quick bullets: Hosted = fastest setup, pay per-use, latency varies with concurrency; Dedicated = reserved GPU pool, predictable latency & throughput, monthly commit. For a 6-week pilot: Hosted estimate cheaper unless they need strict SLA/isolated tenancy.
julia: We should propose a two-stage plan: week 0-1 data ingest & estimator, week 2 evals + rerank tuning, week 3-4 live pilot with sampling, week 5 acceptance runs, week 6 wrap + handover.
rebecca: Looping in security: send me their infosec questionnaire and sample data flows. Also confirm whether they require VPC/private control plane or just encryption at rest + IAM.
kevin: I'll push sales to get questionnaire + example docs.
sarah: For eval prompts — here's a tiny starter set (we'll expand):
```
Prompt A: "Given the customer support ticket, return top-5 relevant KB articles with short rationale."
Prompt B: "Given transaction id, return associated metadata fields and flag anomalies."
```
Include automated pass/fail checks for hallucinations.
julia: Also add a smoke test for toolcall safety: call -> validate idempotent response -> assert no unauthorized fields.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: zenith-pilot/tech-scope -> owners: julia, omar, rebecca. Can upload questionnaire to /projects/zenith.
kevin: Great. Action items: (1) Sales to upload questionnaire by EOD tomorrow (2) Security to review and return RACI within 48h @rebecca (3) Julia to produce one-pager with timeline + acceptance criteria by Mon (4) Omar to assemble model/cost options and rough token/infra estimate by Mon. I'll confirm context-length ask with the customer.
sarah: I'll draft the eval harness and share test queries.
julia: One more: if they want rerank for fraud signals, call that out — may need extra telemetry and a separate acceptance gate.
kevin: Noted. Thanks everyone — ping here when questionnaire lands. :thumbsup:
